scope: Paired same-environment fitting measurements, not hardware or motion-planning validation
cpu: AMD Ryzen 9 9950X; benchmark CPU affinity 4, OpenBLAS/OMP 1 thread; nonexclusive host
notes: Each pair uses the same interpreter/dependencies/input. Exact output assertions do not promise cross-version or cross-device bitwise identity.
Enclosing/cover full fits load previous enclosing.py, fit.py and surface_fit.py; remaining unchanged helpers use the current checkout.
Grid full fits replace previous voxel_fit.py and refine.py; reporting, repaired-surface code and other shared stages are common.
tracemalloc measures allocations inside warmed calls, not process RSS, native runtimes or GPU memory.
Existing robot image parameters were replayed exactly; no rerendering or change to coverage semantics.

enclosing_clouds.timing_scope: complete warm tighten_ball call, input preparation excluded
enclosing_clouds.memory_scope: tracemalloc allocation peak, not RSS or native runtimes

ur5e.timing_scope: complete warm fit_mesh, preloaded input; no load/export
ur5e.memory_scope: tracemalloc allocation peak, not RSS or native runtimes

panda.timing_scope: complete warm fit_mesh, preloaded input; no load/export
panda.memory_scope: tracemalloc allocation peak, not RSS or native runtimes

dense.timing_scope: complete warm fit_mesh, preloaded input; no load/export
dense.memory_scope: tracemalloc allocation peak, not RSS or native runtimes

grid_preparation_and_fits.memory_scope: tracemalloc allocation peak; not RSS, native runtimes or device memory
grid_preparation_and_fits.timing_scope: warm paired calls, preloaded mesh, alternating call order; no export

measurement.timing_scope: paired warm calls, alternating order; imports/warm-up excluded
measurement.memory_scope: tracemalloc peak allocations, not RSS or native/GPU runtime memory
measurement.subdivision_reference: Whole-mesh legacy 1-to-4 reference using public remesh.subdivide; not the Trimesh 5 default remesher

primary.scope: development variants; final production checks are full-fit benchmarks and regression tests

latest.scope: development variants; final production checks are full-fit benchmarks and regression tests

minimum.scope: development variants; final production checks are full-fit benchmarks and regression tests

not_adopted.cuda_direct_cdist: Loss/gradient checks passed, but direct cdist backward was substantially slower for higher ball counts on Torch2.8/RTX5090 Dv2.
not_adopted.cuda_winner_only_gradient: Lower additional Torch memory, but no stable latency improvement for common 24/128-ball cases; no thresholds or configuration added.
